findings.summary: Creator drop workflow states include creator/admin/user approval lifecycle.
Creator submissions stay hidden from users until admin review.
Admin approval validates full publish readiness before public rotation.
Admin drops queue can request changes.
Creator manager exposes submitted, pending, approved, rejected, needs_changes, and expired statuses.
Creator drop route returns typed non-retryable 4xx payloads.
Creator submit modal surfaces safe recovery copy and tracks attempts/success/failure.
Creator drop 4xx policy covers expected permanent client errors.
Focused creator features are mapped to source truth, consumers, telemetry, debug, and 4xx policy.
Creator drop workflow events are registered in the telemetry catalog.
Repo memory records creator workflow chain repair rules.
